findings.F1: The tested idea points the predicted way: the step-5 slope t is +1.70 on 3,436 cases over 506 days, and its size is +0.87 % per case over 5 days (t 3.00, 1,306 days, strength 0.075, 3.9 times the 0.22 % trade cost). In folds B and C alone, the same day-clustered slope at 5 days has t +3.27 (1,056 cases, 236 days). The shortfall therefore comes from folds A and D, and the test already used every coin, fold and day of daily data available, so there is no unused data that could lift it over the bar.
findings.F2: The effect sits in the strongest range positions. Mean 5-day excess return is +3.80 % in the top forecast quintile and −2.55 % in the bottom one. The three middle quintiles show only −0.24 %, −0.22 % and +0.26 %, so a straight-line slope over all bars dilutes it.
findings.F3: Over longer horizons the effect lives in rising and choppy markets, not falling ones. At 10 days the slope t is +3.85 when rising (104 cases), +2.66 when choppy (63) and only +0.51 when falling (125). At 20 days it is +3.03 rising, +1.88 choppy and −0.10 falling. At 5 days all three trends are positive (falling 2.40, choppy 2.83, rising 2.97).
findings.F4: The long side carries more of the effect than the short side at 5 days. The slope t is +2.54 for long cases (547) against +1.74 for short ones (509), with mean excess returns of +1.59 % and −1.28 %.

ideas.idea: In a calm, rising market, the higher a coin's close sits within its 20-day high-low range, the larger its rise over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: When a coin has risen over the past two months and is swinging less than usual, a trader should lean long the nearer it closes to its 20-day high, and short the nearer it closes to its 20-day low, for about ten days.
ideas.name: calm-rising range position

ideas.idea: In a calm market, the nearer a coin's close sits to the top of its 20-day high-low range, the larger its rise over the next 5 days, and the nearer to the bottom, the larger its fall, with the move growing faster than the close's distance from the range's middle.
ideas.consequence: In a calm coin, a trader should take positions mainly when it closes close to a 20-day edge, in that edge's direction, and stay light near the middle of the range.
ideas.name: calm range edge continuation
